messages:
naveen: Heads-up: Cascade-Pro + Toolcall Async (background tool executions with evented completions) are GA in hosted ap-south-1 as of 08:30 PT. Docs: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/hosted/toolcall-async 

zoe: Nice! Is async fully backward compatible with current streaming clients?

naveen: It's opt-in and targeted for long-running tool jobs. Existing streaming stays unchanged. Async flows return a job id immediately and emit completion events you can poll or subscribe to. Example: POST /v1/generate?toolcall=async returns {"job_id":"..."}. See docs for webhooks.

devrel: I'll add Node/Python samples for polling and webhook consumers. Planning a short internal demo tomorrow 9am PT.

support: Any quota/billing notes?

naveen: Billing: tool execution time billed as before; new quota type "async-jobs" limits concurrent background jobs per-account. Defaults are generous; we'll notify tenants with >50 active jobs. Also note a 10-minute default job timeout (configurable per-tenant).

infra-bot: Canary started: ap-south-1 at 5% traffic for 1h. Monitors: async_job_queue_depth, job_latency_p95, webhook_fail_rate. Alerts to #eng-runtime.

zoe: Any known gotchas?

naveen: A couple: webhooks may require retry/backoff handling; large tool outputs are stored in chunked blobs so clients should stream downloads. We'll publish a support playbook at /docs/internal/async-toolcall-playbook.

support: We'll prepare KB and console banner.

devrel: Draft blurb for marketing: "Cascade-Pro + Toolcall Async GA 1: background tool executions and webhook completions for durable interactive workflows." Shorten as needed.

naveen: Thanks all. Deprecation: none for streaming; async is an additional mode. I'll follow up with the migration demo invite and the admin quota opt-up form. :rocket:
